directAnswer: To check if a USB-C charger is charging your laptop, look for charging indicators on the laptop and check the battery status in the operating system settings.
summary: This guide explains how to verify if your laptop is charging via USB-C and provides steps for different operating systems.

sections.heading: USB-C Compatibility
sections.body: Ensure that your USB-C charger is compatible with your laptop. Not all USB-C chargers provide power delivery (PD) required for charging.

sections.heading: Checking Charge Status
sections.body: You can check the charge status through your laptop's operating system settings.

steps.title: For Windows
steps.detail: Click on the battery icon in the taskbar to view the charging status. You can also go to Settings > System > Battery to see detailed information.

steps.title: For macOS
steps.detail: Click the Apple menu, select 'About This Mac', then 'System Report'. Under 'Power', check the 'Charge Information' section for charging status.

steps.title: For Linux
steps.detail: Open a terminal and run the command 'upower -i /org/freedesktop/UPower/devices/battery_BAT0' to check the battery status.

faqs.question: Can I use any USB-C charger to charge my laptop?
faqs.answer: Not all USB-C chargers are created equal; ensure the charger supports power delivery (PD) and matches your laptop's power requirements.

faqs.question: What should I do if my laptop is not charging?
faqs.answer: Check the charger connection, try a different USB-C port, or test with another compatible charger to diagnose the issue.

faqs.question: How can I tell if my USB-C port supports charging?
faqs.answer: Refer to your laptop's specifications or user manual to confirm if the USB-C port supports power delivery for charging.

caveats: Charging performance may vary based on the charger wattage and laptop model.
Some USB-C ports may only support data transfer and not charging.
